title: Ubugingo Buri Inyuma y'Ishusho
intro: Mu gicucu cy'urugendo rukomeye rwo kuva mu butegetsi bw'igitugu, uyu muntu w'amayobera yari ategereje mu butayu. Mu gihe umuyobozi w'ubwoko bwatoranijwe yazamukaga ku musozi wera kugira ngo ahure n'Imana, habaye igeragezwa rikomeye ku basigaye. Uyu muntu yafashe umwanya wo kuvugurura imyizerere y'umuryango wose. Ubwo umuyobozi yagarukaga afite ukuri, hatanzwe igihano kidasanzwe kandi cy'iteka ryose. Ese ushobora kumenya uwo muntu w'umunyabyaha n'umunyabugeni wari we?
clues: Nagenze n'abantu bari barabohowe mu maboko y'umugome ukomeye binyuze mu bimenyetso by'igitangaza.
Ubwo umuyobozi wabo yazamukaga ku musozi kugira ngo ahabwe ubuyobozi, nategereje mu bari basigaye inyuma.
Nakusanyije ibyuma by'agaciro mu mitako yabo maze mbihinduramo ikintu cyatangaga ijwi.
Binyuze muri uku kuremwa, nemeje abantu bose ko babonye imana yabo mu butayu.
Umuyobozi agarutse, bambwiye icyanteye uburiganya nk'ubwo.
Igihano cyanjye muri iyi si cyari uko nta muntu wankoraho cyangwa ngo anyegere, ikimenyetso cy'isoni mfite iteka ryose.

outcome.label: Ibisubizo
options: Baregwa kuba intamenyekana, bavuga iteka ko 'nta muntu wo kuvugana'
Kujugunywa mu muriro wabaye ukonje kandi utuje

arabic: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًۭا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
verse: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it [i.e., its ashes] into the sea with a blast. (20:97)
